comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
'Gentleman thief and pirate legend'
Treasure hunt theme with two relics, available during 17th Century, Period 4 (or via equipping the Adept of Age title from that period). This will be added during a future update called "Extreme North Sea", along with a few other goodies like the Royal Gardener/Marine/Tea Merchant jobs.

Source: gamecity.ne.jp/dol/developer/new_updata2014_02.htm

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Straight from the OGP forum:

"Legendary honorable thief and pirate – requires 17 Century, 4th period Chrono Title.
A quest named “I want to drink this world dry!” from London, Amsterdam, Seville, Lisbon can gives the title upon completing. The quest will require Port Royale permit and 20k+ Trader fame."

There are other 17C-4P chrono quests out there, but most of them also relate directly to Port Royal having already been discovered (Antilles Sea charted, "Country of Pirates" and "Commission from Port Royal" quests from Santo Domingo Maritime mediator). Here's a list of Chrono Quests if anybody's interested in looking at alternatives:

gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Quest/ChronoQuest

As for the relic rewards... well. I don't think I should have all the fun around here. Cheers, and happy treasure hunting.
